title.en: UCI Wireless Indoor Localization: room accuracy, stratified 5-fold cross-validation, seed 0
title.zh: UCI Wireless Indoor Localization：房间准确率，分层 5 折交叉验证，种子 0

dataset.name: wlanrssi
dataset.citation: Bhatt, Wireless Indoor Localization, UCI Machine Learning Repository, 2017, doi:10.24432/C51880

protocol.name: stratified-kfold-5
protocol.summary: 5 folds stratified by groups['room'] (seeded); every row tested once

tables.units: % of rows with the right label

skips.en: the dataset has no coordinates: a radio map over position cannot be fitted
skips.zh: 数据集没有坐标，无法拟合基于位置的无线电地图

skips.en: model-based: the dataset does not publish the access-point positions
skips.zh: 基于模型的方法：数据集未公开 AP 位置

notes.en: Only room labels (1-4) exist. Each localizer gets the room as its floor label and a constant placeholder position (never scored); the table reports room accuracy. The file has no missing readings, so 'fill' changes nothing, and Horus gets the same input with and without it.
notes.zh: 数据只有房间标签（1-4）。每个定位器把房间当作楼层标签，并使用恒定占位位置（不计分）；表格报告房间准确率。文件无缺失读数，'fill' 不改变数据，Horus 填充与否输入相同。

cells.command: python -m benchmarks.labels --dataset wlanrssi --label room --preprocess fill --method benchmarks.baselines:TrainingCentroid --seed 0 --no-download -q
python -m benchmarks.labels --dataset wlanrssi --label room --preprocess fill --method knn --seed 0 --no-download -q
python -m benchmarks.labels --dataset wlanrssi --label room --preprocess fill --method wknn --seed 0 --no-download -q
python -m benchmarks.labels --dataset wlanrssi --label room --preprocess fill --method horus --seed 0 --no-download -q

display: ensemble: median of WKNN, RF, Horus

cells.command: python -m benchmarks.labels --dataset wlanrssi --label room --preprocess fill --method mlp --seed 0 --no-download -q

python -m benchmarks.labels --dataset wlanrssi --label room --preprocess positive --method wknn --seed 0 --no-download -q
python -m benchmarks.labels --dataset wlanrssi --label room --preprocess exponential --method wknn --seed 0 --no-download -q
python -m benchmarks.labels --dataset wlanrssi --label room --preprocess powed --method wknn --seed 0 --no-download -q
python -m benchmarks.labels --dataset wlanrssi --label room --preprocess none --method horus --seed 0 --no-download -q

accuracy.definition: room classification accuracy (4 rooms), as reported

literature.rule: shown: literature entries checked 'verified', 'corrected' or 'unchecked'; hidden: 'unidentified', 'missing' and numbers IndoorLoc 0.1 produced itself
